description: What the independent inventory verifier must RECOMPUTE before a bundle may materialize. Stored booleans and stored hashes are never verifier authority: the verifier replays the evidence, it does not read the run's opinion of itself. This is the same posture the forecast verifier reached only after a closure record was found asserting facts nothing had checked.

recompute.artifactHashes: sha256 of every artifact in the manifest, byte-for-byte
recompute.artifactRowCounts: row count of every Parquet artifact against the manifest
recompute.oracleReproduction: re-derive the weekly state deltas against the observed snapshots and re-evaluate the frozen tolerance
recompute.replayGates: recompute stockout/lost-unit/fill/mean-inventory comparisons from replay_metrics, globally and per market
recompute.cohortIdentity: re-derive the 5/95 cohort assignment from the frozen key, hash version and seed; both fingerprints must reproduce
recompute.holdoutDisjointness: assert calibration and holdout key sets are disjoint and collectively complete
conservation: allocated + residual = node ATP for every allocation pool
no channel demand disappears in aggregation
transfer source retains residual cover and target respects max cover
intervalConsumption: no artifact value is derived from a withheld interval
every skipped interval-dependent row has a governed cold_start_interval_unavailable exception
skipped-row/series/demand shares reconcile with the forecast availability artifact
a market with 100% skipped cold-start SeriesKeys or demand is marked sub-capability unavailable
moneyDiscipline: no cross-currency unit or money aggregation outside approved reporting FX
every money value is integer minor units in its own market currency
lineage: inputBundle fingerprints match the named curated publication
sourceSelectionId names an ACTIVE decision-#73 selection for this scope
forecastAuthority matches the exactly-one active forecast under decision #90
policy resolvedFingerprints reproduce from inventory-policy/2.0.0 for each market

refusals.storedVerdictTrusted: verification that reads `passed` without recomputing it is invalid
refusals.missingArtifact: a manifest entry whose bytes are absent fails the whole bundle
refusals.tamperedArtifact: any hash mismatch fails the whole bundle; there is no partial pass
refusals.staleLineage: a superseded forecast authority or inactive source selection fails the bundle
refusals.nullCoercion: any zero that traces to a withheld interval fails the bundle

output.record: verification.json inside the bundle, or a separately retained verifier record bound to every artifact hash
output.note: Materialization requires `verified`. Activation is a separate append-only event and is NOT granted by verification.
